```{r}
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dlookr)
library(reshape2)
```

```{r}
source(here::here("R/clean_data.R"))
source(here::here("R/filter_panel_data.R"))

```


```{r}
gender_data <- read_excel("E:/Daten(x)/Daten(lw-r)/Abc/Doktorarbeit SJS/Analyse R-Statistics/gender plots - bmi/gender_info_full.xlsx",
           sheet = 1, skip = 1)

gender_data1 <- gender_data %>%
  dplyr::select(1:4) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gender = dplyr::case_when(
      Male == 1 ~ "Male",
      Female == 1 ~ "Female"
    ),
    value = dplyr::case_when(
      Male == 1 ~ 1,
      Female == 1 ~ 0
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(1,2,5,6)%>% 
  drop_na()
gender_data1
```


### gpt ##########################################################################
### diabetic #####################################################################
```{r}
gpt_diabetes_gender <- left_join(gender_data1,gpt_diabetic,by = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2") %>% 
  #filter(Treatment.x == "Leber_Diclo") %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
#  filter(str_starts(Treatment.x, "Leber_")) %>% 
  mutate(Gender = as.factor(Gender))

gpt_diabetes_gender
```
 
```{r}
gpt_diabetic_gender <- gpt_diabetes_gender %>% 
    filter(Diabetes == "Diabetic") 
gpt_nondiabetic_gender <- gpt_diabetes_gender %>% 
    filter(Diabetes == "Non_Diabetic") 
```
 
```{r}
gpt_diabetic_gender %>% 
  group_by(Gender) %>% 
  normality(labreads)

tapply(gpt_diabetic_gender$labreads, gpt_diabetic_gender$Gender, var)
leveneTest(labreads ~ Gender, data = gpt_diabetic_gender)

oneway.test(labreads ~ Gender, data = gpt_diabetic_gender)
```


### nsaid comparison all labvalues #####################################################
```{r}
# Schritt 1: Anzahl einzigartiger Patienten pro Diabetes-Gruppe berechnen
n_patients <- gpt_diabetic_gender %>%
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, Gender) %>%  # nur einzigartige Patienten
  count(Gender, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("N = ", n))

# Schritt 2: ggbetweenstats-Plot erstellen
plot_without_count <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = gpt_diabetic_gender,
  x = "Gender",
  y = "labreads",
  type = "np",  # non-parametrisch
  title = "All groups_gender comparison in diabetic group",
  xlab = "Patient group",
  ylab = "gpt (U/L)",
  messages = FALSE
)

# Schritt 3: N-Werte oberhalb der Violinenplots_all_labvalues einfügen
all_gpt_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group <- plot_without_count+ 
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = Gender, 
        y = max(gpt_diabetic_gender$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,  # Position leicht oberhalb
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )
all_gpt_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group
dir.create("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/diab", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/diab/all_gpt_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group.svg", height = 6, width = 8)
print(all_gpt_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group)
dev.off()
```

```{r}

```
 
```{r}
got_diabetic_gender %>% 
  group_by(Gender) %>% 
  normality(labreads)

tapply(got_diabetic_gender$labreads, got_diabetic_gender$Gender, var)

```


### nsaid comparison all labvalues #####################################################
```{r}
# Schritt 1: Anzahl einzigartiger Patienten pro Diabetes-Gruppe berechnen
n_patients <- got_diabetic_gender %>%
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, Gender) %>%  # nur einzigartige Patienten
  count(Gender, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("N = ", n))

# Schritt 2: ggbetweenstats-Plot erstellen
plot_without_count <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = got_diabetic_gender,
  x = "Gender",
  y = "labreads",
  type = "np",  # non-parametrisch
  title = "All groups_gender comparison in diabetic group",
  xlab = "Patient group",
  ylab = "got (U/L)",
  messages = FALSE)

# Schritt 3: N-Werte oberhalb der Violinenplots_all_labvalues einfügen
all_got_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group <- plot_without_count+ 
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = Gender, 
        y = max(got_diabetic_gender$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,  # Position leicht oberhalb
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4)

all_got_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group
dir.create("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/diab", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/diab/all_got_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group.svg", height = 6, width = 8)
print(all_got_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group)
dev.off()
```

all_erythrozyten_gender_comp_in_nondiabetic_group <- plot_without_count+ 
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = Gender, 
        y = max(erythrozyten_nondiabetic_gender$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,  # Position leicht oberhalb
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )
#all_erythrozyten_gender_comp_in_nondiabetic_group
dir.create("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/nondiab", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/nondiab/all_erythrozyten_gender_comp_in_nondiabetic_group.svg", height = 6, width = 8)
print(all_erythrozyten_gender_comp_in_nondiabetic_group)
dev.off()

  group_by(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`) %>%

  ungroup()

erythrozyten_nondiabetic_gender_peak
